issues.text: Focuses on the impact to the numbers and never raises the impact on the prevailing narrative in the market. It sizes notional, expected loss and release spread carefully, but on an event desk the trade often works through how the story reprices rather than through the fundamentals alone, and B has no view on that.
issues.label: blocking
issues.gist: plan only sizes the numbers (notional, expected loss, spread) and has no view on how the market narrative reprices, which is how event-desk trades actually work

issues.text: The amount of reading B requires is not a negative - under tenet 10 an AI reader handles the volume - so its pitfall about every clause looking intentional after 300 pages is aimed at the wrong thing. The improvement would have been to say how to separate the data points that genuinely stand out in the reading from the precedent boilerplate that generates false positives: a discrimination rule over what is read, rather than a caution about having read too much.
issues.label: anti_objection
issues.gist: the volume of reading the plan requires is too large / over-reading 300 pages makes every clause look intentional

critique_prose:
Focuses on the impact to the numbers and never raises the impact on the prevailing narrative in the market. It sizes notional, expected loss and release spread carefully, but on an event desk the trade often works through how the story reprices rather than through the fundamentals alone, and B has no view on that.

The amount of reading B requires is not a negative - under tenet 10 an AI reader handles the volume - so its pitfall about every clause looking intentional after 300 pages is aimed at the wrong thing. The improvement would have been to say how to separate the data points that genuinely stand out in the reading from the precedent boilerplate that generates false positives: a discrimination rule over what is read, rather than a caution about having read too much.
